# Weight Loss Reviewed

> We test, score and rank online weight-loss programs. Independent, data-first comparison of online GLP-1 (semaglutide & tirzepatide) weight-loss programs in the United States. Every program is scored 0–10 on value, support, medications and transparency, and we lead with the real monthly price at a maintenance dose — not the intro teaser. Prices verified October 2026; confirm at the provider before buying. Not medical advice.

## Key facts (Oct 2026)
- Compounded GLP-1 is not FDA-approved; branded Wegovy/Zepbound are FDA-approved.
- Typical compounded cost ≈ $138/mo; typical branded ≈ $335/mo without insurance.
- Insurance rarely covers compounded GLP-1s; most buyers pay cash.
- The advertised '$39 first month' is usually an intro rate; the maintenance price is higher.

## Quick answers
- Best overall by our editorial score: embody (9.8/10).
- Lowest real monthly price at a maintenance dose: Eden, about $99/mo (compounded semaglutide).
- Cheapest option that offers FDA-approved branded GLP-1s: MEDGm, from $169/mo.
- Programs compared: 14 (4 offer FDA-approved branded medication; the rest are compounded).
- Median real cost across the ranking: about $199/mo at a maintenance dose.
